```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(apply)).
:- use_module(library(pio)).

main :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, L1),
    ( L1 == end_of_file -> true
    ; number_codes(N, L1),
      read_line_to_codes(user_input, L2),
      ( L2 == end_of_file -> M = 0
      ; number_codes(M, L2),
        read_edges(M, Edges0),
        append(Edges0, Flat),
        !,
        count_dist12(Flat, N, Count),
        format("~d~n", [Count])
      )
    ).

read_edges(0, []).
read_edges(M, Edges) :-
    M > 0,
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, L),
    ( L == end_of_file -> Edges = []
    ; parse_pair(L, A, B),
      M1 is M - 1,
      read_edges(M1, Rest),
      Edges = [A, B | Rest]
    ).

parse_pair(L, A, B) :-
    append(ACodes, [0' | Rest], L),
    ACodes \= [],
    number_codes(A, ACodes),
    number_codes(B, Rest),
    B \= 0.

parse_pair(L, A, B) :-
    append(ACodes, [0'\t | Rest], L),
    ACodes \= [],
    number_codes(A, ACodes),
    number_codes(B, Rest),
    B \= 0.

parse_pair(L, A, B) :-
    append(ACodes, [0'\r | Rest], L),
    ACodes \= [],
    number_codes(A, ACodes),
    number_codes(B, Rest),
    B \= 0.

count_dist12(Flat, N, Count) :-
    length(Dist, N),
    maplist(=(inf), Dist),
    bfs(Flat, Dist, N, Count).

bfs(Flat, Dist, N, Count) :-
    nb_setarg(1, Dist, 0),
    queue_step([1], Flat, Dist, N, 0, Count).

queue_step([], _, _, _, Count, Count).
queue_step([Curr|Q], Flat, Dist, N, Acc, Count) :-
    arg(Curr, Dist, D),
    findall(Nx,
            ( member2(Flat, Curr, Nx),
              arg(Nx, Dist, inf) ),
            New),
    length(New, L),
    NewAcc is Acc + L,
    forall(member(Nx, New),
           ( D1 is D + 1, nb_setarg(Nx, Dist, D1) )),
    append(Q, New, Q2),
    queue_step(Q2, Flat, Dist, N, NewAcc, Count).

member2(Flat, U, V) :-
    nth0(I, Flat, U),
    P is I mod 2,
    P == 0,
    J is I + 1,
    nth0(J, Flat, V).
member2(Flat, U, V) :-
    nth0(I, Flat, V),
    P is I mod 2,
    P == 0,
    J is I + 1,
    nth0(J, Flat, U).
```

:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(apply)).
:- use_module(library(pio)).

:- dynamic edge/2.

main :-
    cleanup,
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, L1),
    L1 \== end_of_file,
    number_codes(N, L1),
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, L2),
    ( L2 == end_of_file -> M = 0 ; number_codes(M, L2) ),
    read_all_edges(M),
    setof(F, friend_of_one(F), Fs1),
    !,
    setof(F, friend_of_friend(F), Fs2),
    !,
    count_union(Fs1, Fs2, N, Count),
    format("~d~n", [Count]).
main :-
    format("0~n").

cleanup :-
    retractall(edge(_, _)).

read_all_edges(0).
read_all_edges(M) :-
    M > 0,
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, L),
    ( L == end_of_file -> true
    ; parse_pair(L, A, B),
      assertz(edge(A, B)),
      assertz(edge(B, A)),
      M1 is M - 1,
      read_all_edges(M1)
    ).

parse_pair(L, A, B) :-
    append(ACodes, [C|Rest], L),
    member(C, [0' , 0'\t, 0'\r]),
    ACodes \= [],
    number_codes(A, ACodes),
    number_codes(B, Rest),
    B \= 0.

friend_of_one(F) :- edge(1, F).

friend_of_friend(F) :- edge(1, X), edge(X, F), F \= 1.

count_union(Fs1, Fs2, _N, Count) :-
    append(Fs1, Fs2, All),
    sort(All, Sorted),
    length(Sorted, Count).
```
